attempted_claim: Let O2 be the Cuntz algebra, Aut(O2) its Polish group of *-automorphisms with the point-norm topology acting continuously by conjugation on itself, and let C_O2 be the conjugacy equivalence defined by alpha C_O2 beta iff beta = gamma alpha gamma^{-1} for some gamma in Aut(O2). Determine whether C_O2 is Borel reducible to the orbit equivalence relation of any continuous action of any CLI Polish group on any Polish space. A complete answer is either an explicit CLI Polish group H, a Polish H-space Y, and a Borel map f: Aut(O2) -> Y with alpha C_O2 beta iff f(alpha) is H-orbit-equivalent to f(beta), or a rigorous proof that no such H, Y and Borel reduction exists, e.g. via generic turbulence or a Lupini-Panagiotopoulos CLI-game obstruction.
decisive_failure: No completeTARGET resolution is claimed: neither an explicit CLI host reduction nor a rigorous non-reducibility proof was established. Local lemmas are conditional folklore (CLI Cauchy collapse; naive-metric incompleteness assuming Kirchberg-Phillips uniqueness) and the exact obstruction hypotheses, Rokhlin-density facts, and Aut(O2) CLI status remain unverified after two failed literature calls.
